idea-plugin.name: OpenUnderstand Metrics
idea-plugin.description:
Java source metrics (Cyclomatic, CountLine, MaxNesting, CountDeclMethod, PercentLackOfCohesion, CountClassCoupled) from OpenUnderstand, an open-source implementation of the SciTools Understand API.

Requires Python 3.9+ with openunderstand installed (pip install openunderstand). Set the interpreter with the Python... button in the tool window.
